Title: Happy Path – Secure WhatsApp Dispatch after Validation
Preconditions:
1. Lab report for UHID 123456 is in 'Validated' status.
2. Patient record contains a verified mobile number (+1‑555‑0100) and consent flag for WhatsApp set to true.
3. WhatsApp API credentials are active.
4. System clock synchronized to UTC.
Test Steps: 1.Launch the HMS web portal and login as an authorized diagnostic technician. | 2.Navigate to Diagnostics → Lab Results → Pending Dispatch. | 3.Select the validated report for UHID 123456 and click 'Send via WhatsApp'. | 4.Verify that the system generates an encrypted PDF (AES‑256) and creates a secure download URL with a 24‑hour TTL. | 5.Confirm that the WhatsApp API is invoked and the message containing the link is queued. | 6.Check the audit log for a 'ReportDispatchSuccess' entry with timestamp, UHID, and delivery status. | 7.Open the patient’s WhatsApp on a test device and click the link; ensure the PDF downloads, prompts for password, and opens correctly.
Expected Results:
• Encrypted PDF is generated and stored with SHA‑256 checksum.
• Secure URL expires exactly 24 hours after creation (verified by timestamp comparison).
• WhatsApp message is delivered within 5 seconds and contains the correct link.
• Audit log records a successful dispatch with all required fields.
• Patient can download and view the PDF using the provided password.

Title: Consent Not Provided – Dispatch Blocked
Preconditions:
1. Validated lab report exists for UHID 789012.
2. Patient record shows consent flag for WhatsApp = false.
3. Technician is logged in with appropriate role.
Test Steps: 1.Login to the HMS portal as a diagnostic technician. | 2.Go to Diagnostics → Lab Results → Pending Dispatch. | 3.Select the validated report for UHID 789012. | 4.Attempt to click 'Send via WhatsApp'. | 5.Observe the system response dialog. | 6.Check the audit log for a 'ReportDispatchBlocked' entry. | 7.Verify that no WhatsApp API call is made (network monitor).
Expected Results:
• System displays an error message: “Patient has not consented to WhatsApp communication.”
• Dispatch button remains disabled or action is aborted.
• Audit log records a blocked attempt with reason code 'ConsentMissing'.
• No external WhatsApp request is sent.

Title: Invalid Mobile Number – Graceful Failure Handling
Preconditions:
1. Validated report for UHID 345678 exists.
2. Patient record contains mobile number '12345' (invalid format).
3. Consent flag is true.
Test Steps: 1.Login as diagnostic technician. | 2.Navigate to Pending Dispatch list. | 3.Select the report for UHID 345678. | 4.Click 'Send via WhatsApp'. | 5.Capture the validation response from the system. | 6.Check the error handling log entry. | 7.Verify that no WhatsApp message is sent (API call absent).
Expected Results:
• System validates phone number format and displays: “Invalid mobile number. Please update patient contact details.”
• Dispatch is aborted; no link is generated.
• Audit log records 'ReportDispatchFailed' with error code 'InvalidPhoneNumber'.
• No PHI is transmitted to external services.

Title: Secure Link Expiration – Access After 24 Hours
Preconditions:
1. Report dispatched via WhatsApp 25 hours ago for UHID 901234.
2. Encrypted PDF stored with expiration metadata.
3. Patient consent is true.
Test Steps: 1.Open the WhatsApp message on a test device. | 2.Click the secure download link after 25 hours from dispatch time. | 3.Observe the system response page. | 4.Check the audit log for a 'LinkAccessAttempt' entry. | 5.Attempt to download the PDF and note any error messages. | 6.Verify that the link returns HTTP 410 Gone (or custom expiration page).
Expected Results:
• System displays: “This link has expired. Please request a new report.”
• No PDF is downloaded; HTTP status indicates expiration.
• Audit log records the access attempt with status 'ExpiredLink'.

Title: WhatsApp Service Outage – Retry and Fallback Logging
Preconditions:
1. Validated report for UHID 567890 ready for dispatch.
2. Patient consent true and mobile number valid.
3. WhatsApp API simulator configured to return HTTP 503 for the request.
Test Steps: 1.Login as diagnostic technician. | 2.Navigate to Pending Dispatch and select the report. | 3.Click 'Send via WhatsApp'. | 4.Observe the system’s retry mechanism (max 3 attempts, 10‑second interval). | 5.After retries fail, capture the final error message displayed to the user. | 6.Check the audit log for 'ReportDispatchFailed' with error code 'WhatsAppServiceUnavailable' and retry count. | 7Verify that the report remains in 'Pending Dispatch' status for manual re‑try.
Expected Results:
• System attempts to resend up to three times, each spaced by 10 seconds.
• After final failure, user sees: “Unable to send report via WhatsApp at this time. Please try again later.”
• Audit log captures each attempt and final failure with timestamps and error details.
• Report status is unchanged (remains pending).

Title: Encryption Integrity – Verify PDF Password Protection
Preconditions:
1. Validated report for UHID 112233 ready for dispatch.
2. Patient consent true, mobile number valid.
3. System configured to generate a random 12‑character alphanumeric password per dispatch.
Test Steps: 1.Login as diagnostic technician. | 2.Select the report and initiate WhatsApp dispatch. | 3.Capture the generated password from the system log (masked but verifiable via checksum). | 4.Receive the WhatsApp message and click the secure link. | 5.Attempt to open the PDF without entering a password – note behavior. | 6.Enter the captured password and verify successful decryption. | 7.Compare the PDF checksum before encryption and after decryption to ensure integrity.
Expected Results:
• PDF file is stored encrypted; opening without password prompts for authentication.
• Provided password decrypts the file without error.
• SHA‑256 checksum of decrypted PDF matches original source checksum, confirming integrity.
• Audit log records password generation event with masked hash (no plain text).
